The issuer shows moderate leverage and solid operating profitability, with EBIT of 539M (~8.7% of revenue) and a positive net income margin (~8.1%). Liquidity is adequate (current ratio ~1.28), and equity provides meaningful balance sheet cushion (equity ~38% of assets), but total liabilities remain substantial (about 1.6x equity), limiting upward rating potential.

DECISION: BBB+
